title: PRESENTATION BY SEGAL OF THE ACTUARIAL VALUATIONS AS OF
text:
[VI. BOARD/DEPARTMENT ADMINISTRATION]
PRESENTATION BY SEGAL OF THE ACTUARIAL VALUATIONS AS OF
  JUNE 30, 2026 AND PROPOSED CITY CONTRIBUTION RATES FOR
  FISCAL YEAR 2027-28 AND POSSIBLE BOARD ACTION
summary: Segal will present the actuarial valuations as of June 30, 2026, along with proposed city contribution rates for fiscal year 2027-28, and the board may act on them.

details.action: actuarial valuation presentation; possible board action
